say:6:1311124001:1.text: Excuse me, may I ask who you are and what business you have at Viscount Ludovic's estate? His Lordship dislikes being disturbed without proper arrangement...
say:6:1311124001:1.source_cn: 各位，请留步。请问你们是什么人？为何要前来柳博米尔子爵...

say:7:1311124002:1.text: Hold on, hold on! Did the candelabra just speak?!
say:7:1311124002:1.source_cn: 等等，你先等等！你是个会说话、会动的……烛台？！

say:8:1311124003:1.text: Ah, let me introduce myself! I am Václav, the butler to Viscount Ludovic. It is my duty to manage the daily affairs of Everstill Manor.
say:8:1311124003:1.source_cn: 瓦茨拉夫，为您效劳。我是柳博米尔子爵的管家，负责永寂庄...

say:10:1311124004:1.text: Oh wow, Chippy didn't know Ludovic held such a title!
say:10:1311124004:1.source_cn: 哇，柳博米尔还是一位子爵？

say:11:1311124005:1.text: His Lordship and the former Whiteridge Duke both hail from the Valesa family. The title was bestowed upon him at birth, and the Duke then was his uncle, if I may add.
say:11:1311124005:1.source_cn: 当然！柳博米尔先生与历任白山大公同属瓦勒沙家族，一出生...

say:12:1311124006:1.text: Had it not been for the early demise of His Lordship, he would have succeeded to the title of Earl of Silversparrow from his father. The noble Silversparrow Emblem is a testament to the Valesa family's participation in the First Divine War!
say:12:1311124006:1.source_cn: 如果不是先生早逝，他还会继承来自父亲的银雀伯爵爵位——...

say:13:1311124007:1.text: Oops, I think I may have said too much. How may I assist you today?
say:13:1311124007:1.source_cn: 咳，我说得太多了。诸位客人，你们是……

say:16:1311124008:1.text: Václav, it's me. We've come to see Ludovic regarding an urgent matter.
say:16:1311124008:1.source_cn: 瓦茨拉夫，是我。我们来拜访柳博米尔是有要事相询——很重...

say:17:1311124009:1.text: Ah, Miss Valka! I beg your pardon for my impoliteness, but these guests don't appear to be Graveborn...
say:17:1311124009:1.source_cn: 啊！是瓦丽卡女士，请原谅我的失礼，但这几位并非亡灵……

choice_prompt:19:1311124009.text: Ah, Miss Valka! I beg your pardon for my impoliteness, but these guests don't appear to be Graveborn...
choice_prompt:19:1311124009.source_cn: 啊！是瓦丽卡女士，请原谅我的失礼，但这几位并非亡灵……

say:20:1311124010:1.text: That's right. They are my friends, and they have brought a present for Ludovic.
say:20:1311124010:1.source_cn: 没错，这几位都是很好的人，他们还为柳博米尔带来了一份礼物。

choice_prompt:21:1311124010.text: That's right. They are my friends, and they have brought a present for Ludovic.
choice_prompt:21:1311124010.source_cn: 没错，这几位都是很好的人，他们还为柳博米尔带来了一份礼物。

say:22:1311124013:0.text: Oh, how lovely! This is the blue spiritroot that His Lordship has long desired! With it, the painting he is working on is sure to become a masterpiece!
say:22:1311124013:0.source_cn: 啊，这是子爵先生一直期望获得的冰蓝灵曼根！有了它，子爵...

say:23:1311124014:1.text: Please wait for a moment, I shall inform His Lordship right away.
say:23:1311124014:1.source_cn: 各位，请在前厅稍候，我这就去通报子爵先生。

say:26:1311124011:1.text: These are my friends, and they don't fear us.
say:26:1311124011:1.source_cn: 他们都是朋友，也并不害怕我们。

say:29:1311124012:1.text: Please kindly accept this special gift we've brought for Lord Ludovic!
say:29:1311124012:1.source_cn: 请收下，这是我们给柳博米尔子爵先生特意准备的礼物。

choice:19:1:2.text: We are not against the Graveborn.
choice:19:1:2.male: We are not against the Graveborn.
choice:19:1:2.female: We are not against the Graveborn.

narration:30:13011136:0.text: An odd candelabra blocks your way after you enter the derelict manor.
narration:30:13011136:0.source_cn: 进入庄园废墟后，一个奇怪的烛台拦住了你们。
